questions.q:
Which of the following statement is true?

I. 64 X 55 is even

II. 45 X 75 is even

II. 45 X 75 सम है|
o: Both I and III और II दोनों
Neither I nor IIन तो I और न ही II
questions.s:
I. 64 X 55

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 64 will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 55 will be odd.

Multiplication of an even and an odd number always given an even value.

So, 64 X 55is even.

Hence, statement I is true.

II. 45 X 75

When an even number is multiplied by another even number then their solution will be even. So, 45 will be even.

Similarly, when an odd number is multiplied by another odd number then their solution will be odd. So, 75 will be odd.

Multiplication of an even and an odd number always given an even value.

So, 45 X 75 is even.

Hence, statement II is true.

questions.q: 3. If the seven-digit number 7x5345y is divisible by 110, then the value of (x + 5y) is :
questions.s:
3.(c)

For 7x5345y to be divisible by 110, the given expression should be divisible by 10 and 11. For a given expression to be divisible by 10, it is necessary that its unit digit should be zero.Hence y = 0

For 7x53450 to be divisible by 11, either the sum total of odd places must be equals to sum total of even places or the difference between the number at even places and odd places must be divisible by 11.

So, 7 + 5 + 4 + 0 = 16 and

x + 3 + 5 = x + 8

Now, if we take 16 – (x + 8) =

16 – x – 8 = 0, then x = 8

So, we got y = 0 and x = 8

Hence, [x + 5y] = [8 + 5(0)] = 8
